name: Lilithmon
description: (Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:trickster)(Character)Lilithmon was once revered as a Goddess of darkness but is now reduced to level 1 with considerable physical ability and darkness magic. She unleashes potent corroding darkness and charming magic, and devours the mana of fresh corpses to recover and increase her power.
